item.title: Solution for QR Generator Challenges
item.description:
After a long time without creating a challenge, I finally decided to make a simple one.
This challenge is themed as a QR Code Generator, but the vulnerability is not in the QR Code itself. Below is a simple way to solve it.

  1. Challenge Given

    As usual, the challenge was posted in the Surabaya Hacker Link group. There was no clue at all, so we directly accessed the website. It turned out to be a QR Generator page with name and Instagram input fields.

item.title: Solution for Ramadhan Challenges
item.description: This challenge was created when I was confused about how to explain the LFI bug Local File Inclusion during a secure coding session at STTS. Since I was quite bored with LFI to Local File Read via wrapper, I searched for LFI to RCE methods other than through self/proc/environ and found LFI to RCE via Access Log Poisoning. However, because hosting environments could not read log files in txt format, a file upload feature was created that only allows txt files. Below is the Write Up.
